attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2531310)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/The_Last_of_Us_Part_II
Fandom (thelastofus.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://thelastofus.fandom.com/wiki/The_Last_of_Us_Part_II
notes: Steam only sells The Last of Us Part II Remastered (app 2531310; the Steam schema calls it "Pack"), so its achievement list is used; the original 2020 release is PlayStation only and RAWG lists the Remastered as a separate game. The No Return achievements exist only in the Remastered edition. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough is linked but not written, and only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. thelastofus.fandom.com answers the API with at least 500 linked pages (the API limit); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 3 of 45 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter.
